description: Teach one Oxford Ledge LEARN module a step at a time. Call with module_id and no step for the outline, then step=0, 1, 2 and so on. A step is one lesson section as body_markdown, plus where the lesson has them: a formula, a table, live filing figures each with its as-of date (market prices are withheld and named in `withheld`), and suggested_calls naming Oxford Ledge tools the learner can try the idea on. A check step carries the question and options, NEVER the answer: ask it exactly as written, wait for the learner, then submit their choice with ol_learn_check. hint: true adds the hint to a check step. The last step is the module check. The teaching protocol rides tool_notes. Source: Oxford Ledge LEARN (authored); FREE for every caller, no key needed; nothing is stored.

hint.description: On a check step, include the hint. Only when the learner asks.

module_id.description: Module id such as 'val-1', or its slug ('pe-ratio'), or '<path>/<slug>'.

step.description: 0-based step; omit it for the outline.

name: ol_learn_lesson
